verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at documentation.mailgun.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that maps all documentation files. Doc pages are also served as raw .md URLs, which agents can consume directly, and there are agent-facing pages such as the MCP guide. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use the llms.txt effectively, evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-usage guidance, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404).
